note: Hand-written NEEDLE gold set over one palaeogenomics group's published work — one query per paper, that paper is the single right answer. Unlike a `rag-eval.mjs goldset` set this one is COMMITTED, because it is pinned to named papers rather than to a sampled load-order window: it stays meaningful across re-ingests, which is what open item 4 in docs/RAG-EVAL-LEDGER.md asks for. Authorship on every `gold` was verified mechanically against the Europe PMC author field — an author entry matching BOTH surname and given name — rather than inferred from the topic. The surname alone is ambiguous: a Lancet food-additives trial (PMID 17825405) matches it and belongs to an unrelated researcher, which is the whole reason the check is mechanical. Membership of every `gold` in the hosted index was verified by id through get_by_ids, never by querying the index, which would have selected for documents that retrieve well. 140 of these papers were added to the index by an explicit-PMID ingest on 2026-08-08 (docs/PUBMED-RAG.md §8); before it, 18 of the bibliography's 169 PubMed-indexed papers were in the corpus.

arms.sv: VERNACULAR Swedish — the everyday Germanic register a Swedish speaker actually types: fjällämmel, grottlejon, ullhårig noshörning, skräckvarg, jättesengångare.
arms.svsci: SCIENTIFIC Swedish — the same question carrying Latin/Greek scientific vocabulary and binomials: Lemmus lemmus, populationsstruktur, paleogenomisk, effektiv populationsstorlek. Paired with `sv` on the SAME document, so the gap between the two arms isolates REGISTER from topic. This pairing is the instrument that tested docs/RAG-EVAL-LEDGER.md's previously untested cognate hypothesis; run it with `--langs en,sv,svsci`.

needle.en: Which tool estimates ancient DNA damage patterns and rescales base qualities so deaminated sites are down-weighted?
needle.sv: Vilket verktyg mäter hur gammalt DNA brutits ned och viktar ned de positioner där skadan sitter?
needle.svsci: Vilket program ger approximativa bayesianska skattningar av deamineringsgrad och fragmentering i aDNA, och omskalar baskvaliteter?
needle.title: mapDamage2.0: fast approximate Bayesian estimates of ancient DNA damage parameters.

needle.complementary: Renaud/Orlando. Authentication and contamination assessment — the doctrine the field is built on, in its tooled form. It REPLACED Cooper & Poinar's 2000 'Ancient DNA: do it right or not at all' (pmid:10970224), which is the better-known statement of the same idea but carries NO abstract in PubMed at all, so it can never be embedded and the needle was unanswerable by construction. A hand-written gold set can name a document the index cannot hold; a generated one cannot. `rag-eval.mjs run` now checks membership and says so out loud.
needle.en: What tools exist to test whether ancient DNA data are authentic rather than modern contamination?
needle.sv: Vilka verktyg finns för att avgöra om gammalt DNA verkligen är äkta och inte förorening från nutida människor?
needle.svsci: Vilka metoder kvantifierar postmortem-skademönster och andelen nutida human kontaminering i aDNA-dataset?
needle.title: Authentication and Assessment of Contamination in Ancient DNA.

needle.complementary: Whiteley/Tallmon. The management intervention his genomic-erosion work is diagnosis for.
needle.en: Is bringing in immigrants to a small inbred population usually beneficial, or is outbreeding depression the bigger risk?
needle.sv: Är det oftast bra att flytta in nya individer i en liten inavlad stam, eller är risken för utavelsdepression större?
needle.svsci: Överväger fitnessvinsterna av genetisk räddning risken för utavelsdepression i små isolerade populationer?
needle.title: Genetic rescue to the rescue.

needle.complementary: Green/Paabo. The ancient-hominin half of the field, adjacent to his Neanderthal mtDNA work.
needle.en: What did the first draft Neanderthal genome show about interbreeding with modern humans?
needle.sv: Vad visade det första utkastet till neandertalarnas arvsmassa om att de fick barn med moderna människor?
needle.svsci: Vilken andel neandertalskt genflöde till icke-afrikanska populationer indikerade det första utkastsgenomet?
needle.title: A draft sequence of the Neandertal genome.

needle.complementary: Massilani/Meyer. Sediment DNA at micrometre resolution — the methodological counterpart to his sedaDNA brown bear.
needle.en: Does DNA in cave sediments float freely and migrate between layers, or does it stay put?
needle.sv: Rör sig DNA fritt mellan lagren i grottsediment, eller stannar det där det hamnade?
needle.svsci: Visar mikromorfologisk provtagning i Denisovagrottan att sedimentärt DNA är fritt rörligt mellan stratigrafiska enheter?
needle.title: Microstratigraphic preservation of ancient faunal and hominin DNA in Pleistocene cave sediments.

needle.complementary: Fry/Lynch. The functional assay that TESTS the Wrangel deleterious-load claim instead of inferring it.
needle.en: Has anyone experimentally tested whether the harmful mutations in the Wrangel Island mammoth actually broke the genes?
needle.sv: Har någon faktiskt testat i labbet om de skadliga mutationerna hos mammuten på Wrangels ö verkligen slog ut generna?
needle.svsci: Har funktionella assays av resurrekterade Wrangelmammutgener påvisat loss-of-function-alleler?
needle.title: Functional Architecture of Deleterious Genetic Variants in the Genome of a Wrangel Island Mammoth.

needle.complementary: Jensen-Seaman et al. The critique of the dire wolf de-extinction claim, opposite the paper he co-authored on dire wolf ancestry.
needle.en: What is the argument that the announced dire wolf de-extinction was not actually a de-extinction?
needle.sv: Vad går invändningen ut på att den utannonserade återskapade skräckvargen egentligen inte var någon återskapad art?
needle.svsci: På vilka grunder hävdas att den påstådda de-extinktionen av Aenocyon dirus i själva verket är en fenotypisk approximation åstadkommen genom redigering av Canis lupus?
needle.title: The dire wolf (Aenocyon dirus) resurrection that wasn't.
